set.body: Repair the unnecessary enum-to-sealed-trait migration from P7.4. Restore ScriptSource as an enum using the supported private[ScriptSource] case-constructor syntax; preserve the construction-time inline-byte bound; retain Circe's additive unknown-field behavior; pin exact historical bytes for every ScriptSource case; and keep smart-constructor return types precise. Found by the post-P7.4 audit.
set.title: Repair ScriptSource enum and codec compatibility
